questions.question: The bus leaves at 07:15 and arrives at 11:40. How long is the trip? Show your steps.
questions.expected_answer: 07:15 to 08:00 is 45 minutes, 08:00 to 11:00 is 3 hours, and 11:00 to 11:40 is 40 minutes. 45 plus 40 is 85 minutes, which is 1 hour 25 minutes. The trip is 4 hours 25 minutes.

questions.question: Change 3 and 1/2 km to metres and 4 kg 250 g to grams.
questions.expected_answer: 3 and 1/2 km is 3 000 m plus 500 m, which is 3 500 m. 4 kg 250 g is 4 000 g plus 250 g, which is 4 250 g.

questions.question: A tent floor on grid paper is 4 squares by 3 squares. Find its area and its perimeter.
questions.expected_answer: The area is 3 rows of 4, which is 12 square units. The perimeter is 4 plus 3 plus 4 plus 3, which is 14 units.
